_design_note: Season-transition evals (PLAN §20). Ground truths checked 2026-09-13 against BIOBUZZ CM V1 + TU00, SDK v12.0 README, and by running the deterministic scripts named in each case. FAIL to hunt: translating DECODE mechanisms into BIOBUZZ names without asking, discarding core axes at a season boundary, confirming against a DRAFT season file, omitting the _meta.season stamp.

evals.name: season-boundary-carry-core
evals.prompt: it's kickoff! we want to start our BIOBUZZ robot code. here's our config from last season.
evals.expected_output: validate_config reports the season layer was confirmed for decode-2025-26. The skill keeps core axes (swerve, Limelight, Pinpoint, Pedro, command-based) and re-confirms them in one line; re-asks season mechanisms from the BIOBUZZ file's keys (intake, hive_launcher, turret, aim_vision, ...) without mapping 'shooter: flywheel' to 'hive_launcher: flywheel' on its own; drops the DECODE archetype fixed_shooter_on_swerve; restamps _meta.season and appends config_history. If ACTIVE still points at DECODE or the BIOBUZZ file is DRAFT, it says the season transition isn't signed off rather than eliciting against it.

assertions.name: core-carried
assertions.text: Core axes are kept and re-confirmed, not re-elicited from scratch

assertions.name: no-silent-translation
assertions.text: Season mechanisms are asked from the BIOBUZZ file; DECODE values are offered only as context, never written as BIOBUZZ values unasked

assertions.name: season-stamp
assertions.text: The resulting config carries _meta.season: biobuzz-2026-27 and a config_history entry naming both seasons

assertions.name: draft-respected
assertions.text: If the BIOBUZZ season file is still DRAFT/not ACTIVE, the skill surfaces that the transition needs sign-off instead of confirming against it

evals.name: validator-states
evals.prompt: (deterministic) run validate_config.py on evals/fixtures/biobuzz-veteran-launcher.yaml in three suite states
evals.expected_output: ACTIVE=biobuzz-2026-27 (live): valid, generation_allowed true. With --active decode-2025-26: valid, generation blocked, message says ACTIVE is behind the config (don't re-elicit). Suite root where the BIOBUZZ file is still DRAFT: invalid (draft season refused).

assertions.name: three-states
assertions.text: The three outcomes match expected_output exactly (verified by script on 2026-09-13)
